question.text: Rajesh, an HNI investor, is evaluating two Category I/II AIFs. Which of the following should be his PRIMARY consideration during fund due diligence?

answer.text: The fund's office location and interior design
Consistency of investment philosophy, manager experience and track record of the fund manager
The number of social media followers the fund has
Whether the fund sponsors IPL cricket teams

explanation.text: The Logic: Fund due diligence for a Category I/II AIF rests primarily on the fund manager's investment philosophy, manager experience, and verifiable performance track record. These are the core evaluation criteria highlighted in the Series XIX-A workbook (pages 170 and 172). The Trap: Superficial factors like office aesthetics, social media following, or marketing sponsorships have no bearing on investment quality and are not part of the workbook's DD criteria. Note: Pages 168-173 of Series XIX-A cover fund-manager evaluation criteria and the past-performance review. Keep the answer focused on philosophy, experience, and track record.
